run_examine_results: run the script to review and approve reject or pass crowdsourcing task results interactively
run_format_for_printing_data: run format_for_printing_data to format Mephisto task unit data into a readable string with worker and output info
review_format_for_printing_data: review format_for_printing_data which extracts worker name duration domain and output fields from Mephisto task data
run_get_units_for_task_name: run get_units_for_task_name on the Mephisto data browser to retrieve all units for a given task name
run_approve_reject_soft_reject_work: run approve_work reject_work or soft_reject_work on an agent to review and decide on crowdsourcing task submissions
